newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE says taking part in Cairo Mideast summit.
newsitem.headline: UAE says taking part in Cairo Mideast summit.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates plans to take part in a controversial Middle East economic conference in Cairo next month which aims at integrating Israel into the regional economy, UAE newspapers said on Thursday.

They quoted officials as saying Foreign Minister Rashid Abdullah al-Nuaimi will represent the UAE at the conference, which groups together more than 85 countries and several international organisations.
Egypt has warned Israel that Arab participants at the conference might make difficulties for the Jewish state unless it made substantial progress in Middle East peace negotiations.
